sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Support subdomains (e.g. `test.musicbrainz.org`, the MusicBrainz test server) in the `@include` match, not just the bare domain.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Support the `musicbrainz.eu` domain in the `@include` match, in addition to `musicbrainz.org`.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Replace `@match`/`@exclude` with a single `@include` regex that matches only `/release/<MBID>` and `/release/<MBID>/`, tightening the URL match beyond the previous wildcard-based `@match`/`@exclude` pair.
